name: Galaktion Tabidze
author: delphiknight

sections.description: This plugin pays tribute to Galaktion Tabidze (1892–1959), one of Georgia’s greatest poets. When activated, a randomly chosen line from his celebrated poem მთაწმინდის მთვარე (The Moon of Mtatsminda) will appear in the upper right of your WordPress admin screen on every page.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the galaktion-tabidze folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Enjoy a line of Georgian poetry on every admin page.
sections.faq:
What language is the poem in?

The poem is in Georgian (ქართული). Galaktion Tabidze wrote in Georgian and the lyrics are displayed as he wrote them.

Can I translate the plugin interface?

Yes. The plugin is fully internationalised. You can contribute translations at translate.wordpress.org.
